name: CHUBBY HOLIDAYS
source: Jason lives with his father and his fat stepmother. He also lives with Annabelle, his chubby stepsister. When his father go away for his work, Jason becomes the only man in the house. This vacations will be the more hot of his life !!!​
translation: 杰森与他的父亲和肥胖的继母住在一起。他还和他胖乎乎的继妹安娜贝尔住在一起。当他的父亲去工作时，杰森成为家里唯一的男人。这个假期将是他一生中最热门的假期！！！​
